decisions.reason: A full line of operators presented on its own page is a visible, resource-intensive commitment central to the firm's one-source garage door strategy, so management will persist with it.

The solid wood sectional door is a niche variant with only a mention on the website, but it was launched recently and fits the customization promise, so weak early results can still be blamed on market ramp-up.
The remote-controlled operator complements the newly launched operator line, and dropping it would undermine the justification of that investment.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are part of the core industrial range the firm has committed to, and it is too early to judge them, so they stay.
The insulated glazed variant supports the firm's announced thermal-solution direction and shares tooling with the other industrial doors, which favors persistence.
Featured on its own page, this door is a publicly prominent launch whose sunk development and marketing costs make management unlikely to withdraw it after one year.
